A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DRM/PINN generalization analysis and are readable throughout, including the supplementary proofs and auxiliary lemmas. v3 retains the earlier material and adds Section 8.1.

before.justification: v2 reports mathematical approximation results, generalization bounds and proofs. Neither the main text nor supplementary sections report original empirical outcomes.

after.justification: v3 adds theoretical overparameterization analysis but still reports no original experiments, simulations or data-analysis results.

M1.justification: The DRM/PINN losses, network constructions and empirical minimization procedures in Sections 2–3 are retained. Section 8.1 changes the theoretical analysis without introducing a new solver procedure.

E1.justification: Neither PDF reports datasets or PDE scenarios actually evaluated experimentally. The added overparameterization regime is analyzed mathematically.

E2.justification: Neither version reports evaluated baseline methods. The existing comparisons with prior theoretical generalization bounds are retained.

E3.justification: No experimental evaluation protocol is added or revised. The sampling constructions, losses and network specifications in the retained theoretical setup remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Neither version contains ablations, robustness tests or empirical case studies. Section 8.1 supplies new formal entropy analysis, assessed under T1.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests. The probabilistic statements concern theoretical guarantees.

E6.justification: No numerical or qualitative empirical results are added, removed or revised. The new asymptotic bounds are formal theoretical contributions covered by T1.

T1.justification: Section 8.1 adds Lemma 17 and Theorem 5 on convex-hull covering numbers in H1(Q), with new proof arguments and explicit dimension dependence. It then states a width-independent fixed-point bound r* ≲ d^(3/2) n^(-1/2-1/(2(3d+1))) for the static Schrödinger problem, substantially extending the earlier width-dependent analysis.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list in Section 1.2 and conclusion in Section 4 retain the same scientific claims. The new overparameterization result appears in the appended discussion.

C2.justification: Section 8.1 newly explains why the m/n dependence weakens existing guarantees under overparameterization and interprets convex-hull entropy analysis as providing a meaningful width-independent guarantee. The earlier limitations in Section 4 remain unchanged.

D1.justification: No implementation instructions, hardware information, runtime measurements or code/data access information are added or removed. Existing technical specifications are retained.

R1.justification: The bibliography and related-work section are unchanged. Section 8.1 newly positions Theorem 5 as an H1 extension with explicit dimension dependence of the convex-hull entropy theorem in existing reference [52].

P1.justification: v3 appends Section 8, Discussions, with subsection 8.1 after the auxiliary lemmas. Existing prose is essentially unchanged apart from isolated corrections, including spelling fixes and replacing φ(r) with the already-defined ψ(r) in Section 5.3.

P2.justification: Section 8.1 adds theorem and proof displays at the document's end using the existing layout. Theorem 3 also receives a small boldface notation correction. Neither version contains figures or tables, and retained page layouts are otherwise stable.

improvement.justification: The new width-independent analysis addresses a limitation of v2's m/n bound. However, Theorem 5's proof on page 62 infers containment of a coefficient set in an l1 ball from an inequality that only bounds H1 distance by coefficient distance. This unsupported reverse implication leaves the main addition's justification uncertain, preventing a reliable judgment of net quality improvement.
